root_cause.text: The `struct ionic_cq_resp resp` structure is allocated on the stack in `ionic_create_cq()` without initialization, causing uninitialized stack memory in its reserved fields and conditionally-written array elements to be leaked.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces `struct ionic_cq_resp resp;` with `struct ionic_cq_resp resp = {};` to zero-initialize the structure, preventing the unconditional leak of the 7-byte `rsvd` field and the conditional leak of the 4-byte `cqid[1]` element.

bic_trace_step.reason: In the function `ionic_create_cq()`, the structure `struct ionic_cq_resp resp` is allocated on the stack without initialization (declared as `struct ionic_cq_resp resp;` on line 1045). Only specific fields like `resp.cqid[udma_idx]` and `resp.udma_mask` are populated before the structure is copied to userspace via `ib_copy_to_udata(udata, &resp, sizeof(resp))` on line 1087. This allows uninitialized stack memory in the reserved fields and unwritten array elements of `resp` to be leaked to userspace.
